$schemaVersion.description: Marks the flat format. Optional: a response with no cluster key is read as flat regardless; set it to state the format explicitly.

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch (seconds or milliseconds) after which the client should re-fetch this document. Optional; when absent the client uses its default refresh interval.

inferenceProvider.title: Inference provider
inferenceProvider.description: Selects the inference backend. Setting this key activates third-party mode.

inferenceCredentialKind.title: Credential kind
inferenceCredentialKind.description: Selects the credential source. When set, only that source is used (no fallback).

inferenceGatewayBaseUrl.title: Gateway base URL
inferenceGatewayBaseUrl.description: Full URL of the inference gateway endpoint.

inferenceStreamIdleTimeoutSec.title: Stream idle timeout
inferenceStreamIdleTimeoutSec.description: Extra seconds to wait for model output on a streaming response that is sending only keep-alive pings. Gateway provider only. Default 300.

inferenceGatewayAutoModeServerChecks.title: Server-side Auto mode checks
inferenceGatewayAutoModeServerChecks.description: Temporary setting: sends session details, such as folder paths and a user name, so your gateway’s provider checks risky Auto mode actions.

inferenceCustomHeaders.title: Custom inference headers
inferenceCustomHeaders.description: Extra headers sent with every model request. Routing and tenant headers only: do not put credentials here.

inferenceSessionLifetimeSec.title: Sign-in session lifetime
inferenceSessionLifetimeSec.description: Seconds your identity provider keeps a sign-in valid. The app shows a re-authenticate banner before then.

inferenceGatewayApiKey.title: Gateway API key
inferenceGatewayApiKey.description: API key for the configured inference gateway.

inferenceGatewayAuthScheme.title: Gateway auth scheme
inferenceGatewayAuthScheme.description: How the gateway credential is sent on the wire (Authorization: Bearer vs x-api-key header).

inferenceGatewayOidcAuthFlow.title: Gateway sign-in flow
inferenceGatewayOidcAuthFlow.description: How the IdP sign-in runs: system browser (default) or the OS Microsoft Entra broker.

bearerTokenType.description: Which token to send as the bearer. Use access token for a gateway or proxy that validates as an OAuth resource server.

appendOfflineAccess.description: In access-token mode, add offline_access to scopes so the identity provider returns a refresh token for silent refresh.

resource.title: Resource indicator (RFC 8707)

additionalRedirectReferrerHosts.title: Additional redirect referrer hosts
additionalRedirectReferrerHosts.description: Space-separated hostnames also accepted as the referrer of the sign-in callback, besides the authorization URL’s host.

inferenceGatewayOidc.title: Gateway SSO IdP (OIDC)
inferenceGatewayOidc.description: External IdP for gateway sign-in. The user’s token from this issuer is sent to the gateway as the Bearer credential.

inferenceIdpOidc.description: Your organization’s OpenID Connect identity provider. The user’s token is sent as the Bearer credential to the gateway or the Bedrock proxy.

inferenceCredentialHelper.title: Helper script
inferenceCredentialHelper.description: Absolute path to an executable that prints the credential, optionally with per-request headers.

inferenceCredentialHelperWindows.title: Helper script (Windows)
inferenceCredentialHelperWindows.description: Full path to the script that Windows devices run instead of Helper script. Unset: Helper script runs on every platform.

inferenceCredentialHelperArgs.title: Helper script arguments
inferenceCredentialHelperArgs.description: Arguments passed to the helper script, one per entry, in order. Leave unset to run it with none.

inferenceCredentialHelperTtlSec.title: Helper script TTL
inferenceCredentialHelperTtlSec.description: Seconds the helper script’s output is cached. When it expires, the script runs again. Unset: 3600.

inferenceCredentialHelperTimeoutSec.title: Credential helper timeout
inferenceCredentialHelperTimeoutSec.description: Seconds to wait for the helper script to finish. Raise this if it opens a browser for sign-in. Unset: 60.

inferenceCredentialHelperSilentRefreshEn.title: Re-run helper for silent refresh
inferenceCredentialHelperSilentRefreshEn.description: When the credential expires mid-session, run the helper script again to recover silently. Turn off if it cannot run without user input.

inferenceAnthropicApiKey.title: Claude API key
inferenceAnthropicApiKey.description: Leave blank to sign in with your browser, or to supply the key via a credential helper.

inferenceBedrockRegion.title: AWS region
inferenceBedrockRegion.description: AWS region for the Bedrock runtime endpoint.

inferenceBedrockBaseUrl.title: Bedrock base URL
inferenceBedrockBaseUrl.description: For VPC endpoints or gateway proxies. Enter https:// and the host, with no path.

inferenceBedrockServiceTier.title: Bedrock service tier
inferenceBedrockServiceTier.description: Sent as the X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier header. Leave unset for on-demand.

inferenceBedrockBearerToken.title: AWS bearer token
inferenceBedrockBearerToken.description: Static bearer token for inference. For providers that support profile or helper-script credentials, prefer those.

inferenceBedrockSsoStartUrl.title: AWS SSO start URL
inferenceBedrockSsoStartUrl.description: Enables in-app AWS sign-in (no AWS CLI needed). Set with the three SSO fields below.

inferenceBedrockSsoAccountId.title: AWS SSO account ID
inferenceBedrockSsoAccountId.description: 12-digit AWS account ID assigned to users in IAM Identity Center.

inferenceBedrockSsoRoleName.title: AWS SSO role name
inferenceBedrockSsoRoleName.description: IAM Identity Center permission-set name granting bedrock:InvokeModel* on the account above.

inferenceBedrockProfile.title: AWS profile name
inferenceBedrockProfile.description: AWS named profile to use for Bedrock inference credentials.

inferenceBedrockAwsDir.title: AWS config directory
inferenceBedrockAwsDir.description: Folder with AWS config/credentials. Defaults to ~/.aws when no bearer token is set.

inferenceBedrockAwsCliPath.title: AWS CLI path
inferenceBedrockAwsCliPath.description: Absolute path to the aws executable. Leave unset to find it on PATH.

inferenceVertexProjectId.title: GCP project ID
inferenceVertexProjectId.description: Google Cloud project ID for Vertex AI inference.

inferenceVertexRegion.title: GCP region
inferenceVertexRegion.description: GCP region where your Vertex AI Claude models are deployed.

inferenceVertexBaseUrl.title: Vertex AI base URL
inferenceVertexBaseUrl.description: Private Service Connect endpoint, if you use one.

inferenceVertexOAuthClientId.title: Vertex OAuth client ID
inferenceVertexOAuthClientId.description: Desktop-app OAuth client ID. Enables Sign in with Google instead of a credentials file.

inferenceVertexOAuthClientSecret.title: Vertex OAuth client secret
inferenceVertexOAuthClientSecret.description: Secret for the Desktop-app OAuth client above. Google does not treat such secrets as confidential, so the Admin Console can set it.

inferenceVertexOAuthScopes.title: Vertex OAuth scopes
inferenceVertexOAuthScopes.description: Override the Google OAuth scopes (space-separated). Leave blank for the default.

inferenceVertexOAuthLoginHint.title: Vertex OAuth login hint
inferenceVertexOAuthLoginHint.description: Pre-fill Google's account chooser and forward to your federated IdP. {username} expands to the OS login name.

inferenceVertexWorkforceAudience.title: Workforce Identity audience
inferenceVertexWorkforceAudience.description: Workforce-pool provider audience. When set, sign-in uses your own IdP plus a GCP STS exchange instead of a Google identity.

inferenceVertexWorkforceUserProject.title: Workforce Identity billing project
inferenceVertexWorkforceUserProject.description: GCP project for STS billing and quota. Defaults to the Vertex project ID above.

inferenceVertexWorkforceAuthFlow.title: Workforce Identity sign-in flow
inferenceVertexWorkforceAuthFlow.description: How the IdP sign-in runs: system browser (default) or the OS Microsoft Entra broker.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth client ID of the desktop app registration at your identity provider (public client, PKCE).

issuer.title: Issuer URL
issuer.description: HTTPS issuer with OIDC discovery. Set this, or set the authorization and token URLs instead.

authorizationUrl.title: Authorization URL
authorizationUrl.description: HTTPS authorization endpoint. Used with the token URL when no issuer is set.

tokenUrl.title: Token URL
tokenUrl.description: HTTPS token endpoint. Used with the authorization URL when no issuer is set.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Space-separated scopes. Defaults to openid profile email offline_access.

redirectPort.title: Redirect port
redirectPort.description: Fixed loopback port for the sign-in redirect. Leave unset to use a free port each time.

redirectHost.title: Redirect host
redirectHost.description: Use localhost only if your IdP’s registered redirect URI specifies it.

omitOfflineAccess.title: Omit offline_access
omitOfflineAccess.description: Turn on only if your identity provider rejects offline_access on this client. Users then sign in again each time the token expires.

additionalRedirectReferrerHosts.title: Additional redirect referrer hosts
additionalRedirectReferrerHosts.description: Space-separated hostnames also accepted as the referrer of the sign-in callback, besides the authorization URL’s host.

inferenceVertexWorkforceOidc.title: Workforce Identity IdP (OIDC)
inferenceVertexWorkforceOidc.description: Your organization’s OpenID Connect identity provider. Users sign in there, and the app exchanges their ID token at GCP STS.

inferenceVertexCredentialsFile.title: GCP credentials file path
inferenceVertexCredentialsFile.description: Full path to a service-account JSON file. Unset: Application Default Credentials.

inferenceFoundryResource.title: Azure AI Foundry resource name
inferenceFoundryResource.description: Azure AI Foundry resource name used to construct the endpoint URL.

inferenceFoundryBaseUrl.title: Azure AI Foundry base URL
inferenceFoundryBaseUrl.description: Full base URL for a gateway or proxy in front of Foundry, path included (replaces https://RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic).

inferenceFoundryApiKey.title: Azure AI Foundry API key
inferenceFoundryApiKey.description: API key for Azure AI Foundry inference.

inferenceFoundryTenantId.title: Entra ID tenant ID
inferenceFoundryTenantId.description: Directory (tenant) ID of the Entra ID app registration that has the Cognitive Services scope.

inferenceFoundryClientId.title: Entra ID client ID
inferenceFoundryClientId.description: Application (client) ID of the Entra ID app registration. Device-code sign-in requires the app to allow public client flows.

inferenceFoundryAuthFlow.title: Entra ID sign-in flow
inferenceFoundryAuthFlow.description: How Entra sign-in runs: device code (default), system browser, or the OS identity broker.

otlpEndpoint.title: OTLP endpoint
otlpEndpoint.description: Where OpenTelemetry logs and metrics are sent. Leave blank to disable.

otlpProtocol.title: OTLP protocol
otlpProtocol.description: Transport protocol for the OpenTelemetry exporters.

otlpHeaders.title: OTLP headers
otlpHeaders.description: Static headers for routing and tenants only. No credentials here: use Collector authentication or the OTLP headers helper script.

otlpAuthMode.title: Collector authentication
otlpAuthMode.description: inference-credential sends a user’s bearer-token inference credential to the collector. Use it only for a collector you operate.

otlpHeadersHelper.title: OTLP headers helper script
otlpHeadersHelper.description: Full path to a helper script that prints collector headers as JSON. They take priority over OTLP headers and Collector authentication.

otlpResourceAttributes.title: Resource attributes
otlpResourceAttributes.description: Extra attributes to attach to every span, metric and log. An enduser.id set here takes priority over the signed-in user’s identity.

otlpDesktopLogLevel.title: Desktop telemetry export level
otlpDesktopLogLevel.description: Lowest level of the Claude Desktop application’s own events to export, separate from Cowork and Code sessions. Unset: error.

items.description: Known values are listed; a client ignores a value it does not know, so a newer client's vocabulary is storable as is.

otlpContentCapture.title: Content capture
otlpContentCapture.description: Content categories Claude Desktop sends unredacted to your collector. `userPrompts` also sends Claude’s responses.

otlpTracesEnabled.title: Export traces
otlpTracesEnabled.description: Also export OpenTelemetry traces from Cowork tasks and Code sessions. Uses Claude Code’s session tracing.

otlpAttrMaxChars.title: Telemetry attribute length limit
otlpAttrMaxChars.description: Maximum length, in characters, of captured content such as a raw API body. Unset: 61,440 in Cowork tasks and Code sessions.

inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow.title: Max tokens per window
inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow.description: Caps each user’s input and output tokens per window. Cached tokens do not count, so it does not cap your bill. Unset: no limit.

inferenceTokenWindowHours.title: Token cap window
inferenceTokenWindowHours.description: Length of each token cap window, in hours. The count resets to zero when a window ends.

coworkTabEnabled.title: Allow Cowork
coworkTabEnabled.description: Enable Cowork. Claude works on longer tasks like research, analysis, and documents.

x-deprecations.effect: releases that follow 4.4212 and its hot fixes will ignore it, and earlier releases go on reading it. On the releases that ignore it, a device profile that holds nothing but settings past their deprecation date will have no effect, as if it were not installed

isClaudeCodeForDesktopEnabled.title: Allow Code
isClaudeCodeForDesktopEnabled.description: Enable Code. Claude writes and runs code.

sshHostAllowlist.title: SSH host allowlist
sshHostAllowlist.description: SSH hosts for Code sessions. Unset: off, unless the device’s Claude Code managed settings list hosts. * allows any host.

sshClientPath.title: SSH client program
sshClientPath.description: Absolute path to the OpenSSH ssh program the app runs for SSH sessions. Unset: the first ssh on the user’s PATH.

sshTransport.title: SSH connection engine
sshTransport.description: How Code connects over SSH: with the OpenSSH ssh program on the device, or with the app’s built-in SSH library. Unset: the app’s default.

chatTabEnabled.title: Allow Chat
chatTabEnabled.description: Enable Chat. Quick questions and drafting.

x-deprecations.effect: releases that follow 4.4212 and its hot fixes will ignore it, and earlier releases go on reading it. On the releases that ignore it, a device profile that holds nothing but settings past their deprecation date will have no effect, as if it were not installed

chatAdvancedFileAnalysisEnabled.title: Advanced file analysis
chatAdvancedFileAnalysisEnabled.description: Allow Claude to run code in a local sandbox to analyze attached files it can’t read natively — like Excel and PowerPoint.

x-deprecations.effect: releases that follow 4.4212 and its hot fixes will ignore it, and earlier releases go on reading it. On the releases that ignore it, a device profile that holds nothing but settings past their deprecation date will have no effect, as if it were not installed

desktopHome.title: Desktop home
desktopHome.description: Unified Claude: Chat and Cowork in one view. It replaces Allow Chat, Advanced file analysis, and Allow Cowork.

chatSessionRetentionDays.title: Chat retention period
chatSessionRetentionDays.description: Delete chats, with their files, after this many days without activity. Unset: no deletion. Projects and memory stay.

coworkSessionRetentionDays.title: Cowork retention period
coworkSessionRetentionDays.description: Delete Cowork tasks, with their uploads and outputs, after this many days without activity. Unset: no deletion. Spaces and memory stay.

codeSessionRetentionDays.title: Code retention period
codeSessionRetentionDays.description: Delete Code sessions, conversation included, after this many days without activity. Unset: no deletion. Uncommitted work stays on disk.

isDesktopExtensionEnabled.title: Allow desktop extensions
isDesktopExtensionEnabled.description: Let Claude Desktop load desktop extensions (.dxt and .mcpb files). Unset: on where users sign in with Claude.ai.

isDesktopExtensionSignatureRequired.title: Require signed extensions
isDesktopExtensionSignatureRequired.description: Reject desktop extensions that are not signed by a trusted publisher.

disableAutoUpdates.title: Block auto-updates
disableAutoUpdates.description: Stop Claude Desktop from fetching updates entirely (no time limit). You’ll need to push new versions yourself.

installedUpdateEnforcementEnabled.title: Restart to apply installed updates
installedUpdateEnforcementEnabled.description: With auto-updates blocked, Claude restarts by itself for a newer version installed while it was open. On Windows it may stay closed.

installedUpdateEnforcementHours.title: Installed-update enforcement window
installedUpdateEnforcementHours.description: Hours before Claude restarts for a newer version installed while it was open. Unset: 72 hours, then when idle. A number skips the idle wait.

autoUpdaterEnforcementHours.title: Auto-update enforcement window
autoUpdaterEnforcementHours.description: Hours before a downloaded update force-installs. Only applies when auto-updates are enabled. Blank = 72-hour default.

updateViaUpdatesHost.title: Check for updates on releases.claude.com
updateViaUpdatesHost.description: Read the update feed from releases.claude.com so api.anthropic.com can stay blocked.

releaseChannel.title: Release channel
releaseChannel.description: On Stable, devices take each release as it rolls out. On Staggered, they update less often, usually a week or more behind. Unset: Stable.

disableFeatureDiscovery.title: Hide feature announcements
disableFeatureDiscovery.description: Hide unprompted feature announcements: the “What’s new” nudge after an update and new-feature tips. Users can still open release notes.

relaunchEnforcementHours.title: Configuration relaunch window
relaunchEnforcementHours.description: Hours users can keep working after a configuration change that needs a restart. 0: restart required at once. Unset: 24 hours.

configRecheckIntervalMinutes.title: Configuration re-check interval
configRecheckIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between the running app’s checks for a changed managed configuration. Blank = 10 minutes.

modelDiscoveryEnabled.title: Model discovery
modelDiscoveryEnabled.description: Auto-populate the model picker from the provider at launch.

modelPrefer1mContext.title: Use 1M wherever it’s available
modelPrefer1mContext.description: Every model that offers 1M context shows only its 1M option in the model picker.

name.title: Model ID
name.description: Model ID exactly as the provider expects it. The first entry is the default model.

labelOverride.title: Display name
labelOverride.description: Shown in the model picker. Leave blank to auto-format from the ID.

supports1m.title: Offer 1M-context variant
supports1m.description: Adds a 1M-context variant of this model to the picker. Set only if the deployment accepts 1M-token context for it.

prefer1m.title: Only show the 1M option
prefer1m.description: Shows one option for this model and requests 1M from your provider. Does nothing unless the entry offers 1M.

anthropicFamilyTier.title: Tier alias
anthropicFamilyTier.description: The Claude tier this model stands in for. A tier alias such as ‘opus’ then uses this model.

isFamilyDefault.title: Default for tier
isFamilyDefault.description: When several models share a tier alias, marks this one as the model the alias resolves to. Otherwise the first listed wins.

behavesAs.title: Claude model behind this ID
behavesAs.description: The Claude model behind an ID that the app cannot identify, such as a gateway alias. The ID gets that model’s effort levels and limits.

maxEffort.title: Max effort
maxEffort.description: Highest effort level offered for this model. Claude Desktop hides higher levels and never requests them. An unrecognized value means low.

inferenceModels.title: Model list
inferenceModels.description: Override the auto-discovered model list. First entry is the default.

defaultModelEffort.title: Default model effort
defaultModelEffort.description: Effort level the default model (the first listed model) starts at, instead of Anthropic’s recommended level.

alwaysStartWithDefaultModel.title: Always start with the default model
alwaysStartWithDefaultModel.description: Each new conversation or task starts on the default model and effort, not the user’s last choice. Users can still change both for that one.

inferenceModelPricingEnabled.title: Show estimated cost
inferenceModelPricingEnabled.description: Show an estimated cost on the Usage page, at Anthropic list price unless you set a multiplier or per-model rates.

inferenceModelPricingMultiplier.title: Price multiplier
inferenceModelPricingMultiplier.description: Scales every estimated cost (0.85 = 85% of the price); between 0 and 1.

name.title: Model ID
name.description: A model ID from the list above, or another ID or alias your provider serves. A built-in Claude ID also covers its dated and provider forms.

cacheReadPerMtok.title: Cache read
cacheReadPerMtok.description: USD per million prompt-cache read tokens.

cacheWritePerMtok.title: Cache write
cacheWritePerMtok.description: USD per million prompt-cache write tokens (5-minute and 1-hour writes alike).

inferenceModelPricing.title: Model pricing
inferenceModelPricing.description: Per-model rates replacing Anthropic list price in the Usage page’s estimate.

modelCatalogEnabled.title: Model catalog metadata
modelCatalogEnabled.description: Fetch Anthropic’s model catalog for model picker names, descriptions and effort options. When off, the app uses only its bundled copy.

modelCatalogUrl.title: Model catalog URL
modelCatalogUrl.description: Get the model catalog from a mirror inside your network instead of downloads.claude.ai.

serverName.title: Server name
serverName.description: Name of the plugin-delivered MCP server this policy applies to.

toolName.title: Tool
toolName.description: MCP tool name as the server reports it.

permission.title: Permission
permission.description: Approval state locked for this tool. Unlisted tools stay user-controlled.

tools.title: Tool policy
tools.description: Per-tool approval locks for this server.

orgPluginSettings.title: Organization plugin settings
orgPluginSettings.description: Locks tool permissions on the MCP servers that plugins provide.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the marketplace comes from: a GitHub repository (set repo), a Git remote (set url) or a hosted marketplace.json file (set url).

repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/repo form. Case-insensitive.

path.title: Subpath

expectedName.title: Expected name
expectedName.description: Rejects the marketplace if its manifest name differs.

installationPreference.title: Installation
installationPreference.description: Whether users install plugins themselves or get them automatically.

credentialKind.description: Sent with a fetch: nothing (unset), the user’s Git credential, a helper script’s output, or the gateway or bootstrap credential (url only).

allowedPluginMarketplaces.description: Git repositories or hosted marketplace.json files shown as plugin marketplaces in the Directory’s Organization tab.

userPluginMarketplacesEnabled.description: Let users add plugin marketplaces. When off, the app hides the ones your organization did not add and normally does not load their plugins.

userPluginUploadsEnabled.title: Allow user-added plugins
userPluginUploadsEnabled.description: Allow users to add their own plugins. When off, the app hides every option for adding one and refuses uploads.

deploymentOrganizationUuid.title: Organization UUID
deploymentOrganizationUuid.description: A UUID you generate. Tags telemetry so Anthropic support can find your events, and users’ local data is stored under it. Not used for auth.

disableEssentialTelemetry.title: Block essential telemetry
disableEssentialTelemetry.description: Crash, error, and performance reports to Anthropic.

disableNonessentialServices.title: Block nonessential services
disableNonessentialServices.description: Connector icons, hosted artifact previews, MCP Apps widgets and the Linux spellcheck dictionary. Widgets fall back to text.

name.description: Must be unique. A rename resets each user’s on/off choice, tool permissions and device sign-in, and can break a plugin server’s match.

server.description: Which bundled connector this entry turns on. Set instead of a transport; each built-in server has its own fields.

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Your organization’s Microsoft Entra directory (tenant) ID.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth app client ID for this built-in server.

azureCloud.title: Azure cloud
azureCloud.description: Microsoft cloud for sign-in and Graph. Use global for commercial Microsoft 365. US Government clouds need your own app registration.

continuousAccessEvaluation.title: Continuous Access Evaluation
continuousAccessEvaluation.description: Requests Microsoft Graph tokens that last up to about 28 hours but can be revoked within minutes. “disabled” keeps one-hour tokens.

name.title: Name
name.description: Must be unique. A rename resets each user’s on/off choice, tool permissions and device sign-in, and can break a plugin server’s match.

headers.description: Static headers sent on every request: routing and tenant headers only. No credentials here: use the headers helper script for those.

headersHelper.description: Script that prints the auth header as a JSON object to stdout. Runs before each request (cached for the TTL below).

headersHelperArgs.title: Headers helper arguments
headersHelperArgs.description: Arguments passed to the headers helper script, one per entry, in order. Leave unset to run it with none.

headersHelperTtlSec.title: Helper cache TTL (sec)
headersHelperTtlSec.description: How long the helper’s headers are reused before it runs again, in seconds. Defaults to 300.

headersHelperRefreshBufferSec.title: Helper refresh buffer (sec)
headersHelperRefreshBufferSec.description: Seconds before the TTL expires at which the helper re-runs mid-session. Defaults to 60. Keep it larger than the helper’s typical runtime.

managedMcpServers.title: Managed MCP servers
managedMcpServers.description: Org-pushed MCP servers: remote (HTTP/SSE) or local (stdio command).

mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled.title: Allow persistent tool approvals
mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled.description: Offer the persistent “Always allow” approval options for MCP tools. Disable to keep tool approvals per-call or session-scoped only.

mcpScheduledTaskApprovalLifetimeDays.title: Scheduled-task tool approval lifetime
mcpScheduledTaskApprovalLifetimeDays.description: Days a scheduled task can reuse a persistent MCP tool approval before it asks again. 0 turns reuse off. Unset: no limit.

isLocalDevMcpEnabled.title: Allow local MCP servers
isLocalDevMcpEnabled.description: Lets users run local (stdio) MCP servers added in Developer settings. On third-party deployments, off also stops plugins’ local servers.

serverUrl.title: Server URL pattern
serverUrl.description: URL pattern a plugin’s remote server must match, with * wildcards.

allowedPluginMcpServers.title: Allowed plugin MCP servers
allowedPluginMcpServers.description: Remote MCP servers that user-installed and marketplace plugins can connect, as URL patterns. Empty list: none. Unset: no limit.

serverUrl.title: Server URL pattern
serverUrl.description: URL pattern of the remote servers to block, with * wildcards.

deniedPluginMcpServers.title: Blocked plugin MCP servers
deniedPluginMcpServers.description: URL patterns of remote MCP servers that plugins cannot connect, even if the Allowed plugin MCP servers list allows them.

mcpToolTimeoutSec.title: MCP tool call timeout
mcpToolTimeoutSec.description: Per-call timeout for MCP tool calls, in seconds. Unset: 180 in Chat and Cowork.

disabledBuiltinTools.title: Disabled built-in tools
disabledBuiltinTools.description: Built-in tools, or rules such as Read(//etc/**), blocked in Cowork and Code. Shell commands do not fully follow file-path rules.

disableBundledSkills.title: Disable bundled skills and workflows
disableBundledSkills.description: Disables Claude Code’s bundled skills and workflows (deep-research and similar). Use where WebFetch/WebSearch aren’t available.

skillCreationEnabled.title: Allow user-created skills
skillCreationEnabled.description: Let users create and upload their own skills, and let Claude save skills. Skill files added outside the app are not blocked.

skillScanningEnabled.title: Scan user-created skills
skillScanningEnabled.description: Run a security scan on each skill a user creates or uploads before it can be used. Skills that fail the security scan are blocked.

scheduledTasksEnabled.title: Allow scheduled tasks
scheduledTasksEnabled.description: Allow scheduled tasks in Cowork and Code. When off, scheduling is hidden, existing tasks stop running and Claude cannot create new ones.

projectsEnabled.title: Allow projects
projectsEnabled.description: Let users group chats and Cowork tasks into projects. When off, projects are hidden, not deleted.

keepAwakeEnabled.title: Allow keep awake
keepAwakeEnabled.description: Let Claude keep the device awake. When off, Claude never prevents sleep and hides its keep-awake switches.

developerModeEnabled.title: Allow Developer Mode
developerModeEnabled.description: Let users turn on Developer Mode. When off, the app’s developer tools and the option to install an unpacked extension are unavailable.

quickEntryDefaultShortcut.title: Default Quick Entry shortcut
quickEntryDefaultShortcut.description: Set the shortcut that opens Quick Entry, such as Ctrl+Alt+K, for users who haven’t set their own in Settings. Use “off” for no shortcut.

quickEntryScreenshotsEnabled.title: Allow screenshots of the screen and other apps
quickEntryScreenshotsEnabled.description: Let users screenshot their screen or other apps’ windows in Quick Entry on macOS. When off, it never asks for Screen Recording access.

quickEntryFileSharingEnabled.title: Allow sharing files open in other apps
quickEntryFileSharingEnabled.description: Let users attach the file open in another app’s window in Quick Entry on macOS. When off, it never asks for Accessibility access.

builtinToolPolicy.title: Built-in tool policy
builtinToolPolicy.description: Approval per tool or rule such as Bash(curl *). “ask” prompts the user before each matching call. To block, use Disabled built-in tools.

autoModeEnabled.title: Allow Auto mode
autoModeEnabled.description: Offer Auto mode, where Claude decides which actions need approval. Unset: in Code only. True adds Cowork.

disableBypassPermissionsMode.title: Disable bypass permissions mode
disableBypassPermissionsMode.description: Remove the bypass permissions mode from Code sessions and Cowork tasks, so Claude always follows the permission policy. Off by default.

toolSearchEnabled.title: Enable tool search
toolSearchEnabled.description: Load MCP tool definitions only when Claude needs them (tool search), instead of keeping all of them in context.

skipWebFetchPreflight.title: Skip WebFetch domain check
skipWebFetchPreflight.description: Skip Claude Code’s WebFetch domain lookup against api.anthropic.com in Code sessions. Off by default; turn on when that host is blocked.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute folder path. May start with ~ or one of the listed %VAR% tokens, expanded per user. Subfolders are included.

isDefaultSelected.title: Pre-select on new task
isDefaultSelected.description: Shows as a folder chip on the new-task page and skips the trust prompt. Users can remove it.

mode.title: Access mode
mode.description: With `ro`, Cowork can view the folder but not change it. In Code this mostly limits file tools, not shell commands.

allowedWorkspaceFolders.title: Allowed workspace folders
allowedWorkspaceFolders.description: Folders that Claude can use in chat projects, Cowork and Code. Code’s shell commands are only partly limited. Unset: all folders.

blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories.title: Block reads outside working directories
blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories.description: Keep Claude’s file tools from reading outside a Code session’s working directories. Shell commands are only partly limited.

coworkEgressAllowedHosts.title: Allowed egress hosts
coworkEgressAllowedHosts.description: Hosts reachable from Chat, Cowork and Code’s sandbox. Empty: none. Unset: none, except in Code when a local file is the only configuration.

coworkVmIpv6Enabled.title: Enable IPv6 in the workspace VM
coworkVmIpv6Enabled.description: Give the Cowork workspace VM an IPv6 address so Claude’s tools can reach IPv6-only hosts through the device. macOS and Windows only.

endUserAttribution.title: End-user attribution
endUserAttribution.description: Show the signed-in user’s identity in the app, add it to Claude’s system prompt, and send it to your OpenTelemetry collector as enduser.id.

userContentRendererUrl.title: Artifact preview iframe origin
userContentRendererUrl.description: HTTPS origin of the server that artifact and file previews load from. Unset: www.claudeusercontent.com.

organizationInstructions.title: Organization instructions
organizationInstructions.description: Appended to Claude’s system prompt in Chat, Cowork, and Code. Guidance the model follows, not an enforced control. Up to 3,000 characters.

builtinBrowserEnabled.title: Allow the built-in browser
builtinBrowserEnabled.description: A browser in Cowork and Code where users and Claude can open and work with web pages. Site sign-ins stay on the device until cleared.

builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy.title: Default site policy in the built-in browser
builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy.description: Whether Claude may open sites in the built-in browser by default. Users can still view any site. Unset: allow.

builtinBrowserAllowedDomains.title: Allowed sites in the built-in browser
builtinBrowserAllowedDomains.description: Sites Claude may open, read, and act on in the built-in browser when the default site policy is block. Users can still view other sites.

builtinBrowserBlockedDomains.title: Blocked sites in the built-in browser
builtinBrowserBlockedDomains.description: Sites Claude may not open, read, or act on in the built-in browser when the default site policy is allow. Users can still view them.

disableDeploymentModeChooser.title: Disable Claude.ai sign-in
disableDeploymentModeChooser.description: Users see only this provider at the login screen. The option to sign in to Claude.ai is hidden.

disableDeepLinkRegistration.title: Disable claude:// deep-link handling
disableDeepLinkRegistration.description: Stop external apps and websites from opening Claude Desktop via claude:// links.

microsoftAuthBroker.title: Microsoft 365 native sign-in broker
microsoftAuthBroker.description: How Microsoft 365 signs in. “auto”: OS identity broker, else browser. “disabled”: browser only. “required”: fails without the broker.

microsoftAuthDefaultAccount.title: Microsoft 365 sign-in with the Windows account
microsoftAuthDefaultAccount.description: “enabled”: on Windows, connecting Microsoft 365 uses the work account already signed in to Windows. “disabled”: account picker.

deploymentDisplayName.title: Deployment display name
deploymentDisplayName.description: Overrides the provider label shown in the sidebar footer, user-menu header, and connection-error banner.

deploymentDisplaySubtitle.title: Deployment display subtitle
deploymentDisplaySubtitle.description: Optional detail shown after the deployment display name in the account-menu header.

disableConfigDeprecationWarnings.title: Hide configuration deprecation warnings
disableConfigDeprecationWarnings.description: Hide the in-app warning that your configuration uses a deprecated field. A final reminder still shows in the 24 hours before the cut-off.

inferenceTokenWarningPercent.title: Token limit warning
inferenceTokenWarningPercent.description: Warn users once they have used this percent of their token limit. Unset: 75. At 100, the only warning comes at the limit.

command.title: Program
command.description: Full local path to the program or executable script.

platformOverrides.description: Set a different program for Windows, macOS or Linux. Devices on a system you leave out run the setting’s own program.

sessionStatusLine.title: Status line
sessionStatusLine.description: Claude runs this program and shows the first line it prints above the message box in Cowork, Chat and Code. Off unless set.

enabled.title: Enable import
enabled.description: Lets users import a Claude.ai data export and earlier Claude sessions on this device from Settings → Import.

allowedOrganizationUuids.title: Organizations users may import from
allowedOrganizationUuids.description: When set, users import by sign-in only, and only from the Claude.ai organizations with these IDs.

automatic3pImport.title: Automatically import earlier third-party sessions
automatic3pImport.description: Copy this computer’s earlier third-party sessions into the app once, in the background. Independent of `enabled`.

exportEnabled.title: Enable session export
exportEnabled.description: Lets users export this device’s chats, Cowork tasks and Code sessions as a zip to import elsewhere. No effect unless Enable import is on.

bannerBehavior.title: Import prompt banner
bannerBehavior.description: Prompt to import on a new chat or task, if Enable import is on. `show`: always. `detect`: if earlier Claude sessions are found. Unset: off.

BootstrapConfig.description: Per-user bootstrap configuration response in the flat format (`$schemaVersion` 1): bootstrapable keys by their managed-configuration key names at top level. Structural reference for editor autocomplete — the client applies further validation that this schema does not express (https-only and non-loopback URLs, origin-pinning under gateway SSO). Unrecognised keys are ignored. A node marked `x-readers` is read by the clients it names (`desktop` = Claude Desktop, `m365` = the Claude add-in for Microsoft 365); an unmarked node is read by Claude Desktop only. The marker is per key; which providers a client supports is that client's own list. A key node's `x-whenUnreadable` says what Claude Desktop does when the key is present but its value is invalid (wrong type, malformed, or no usable entry; `null` and a blank string count as not set): `{"applies": value}` means it applies that value; `{"unusable": true}` means it treats the key as set but unusable (an invalid managed MCP server list keeps plugin-provided servers' tools blocked rather than allowing them), and a server that mirrors the app should do the same. A key node without it is treated as not set in that case. Each key node's `x-availableInVersion` is the first Claude Desktop release that reads the key; the app names its version as `Claude/<version>` in the User-Agent of the request, so a server can leave out keys the requesting build does not read yet. Below a key, releases are stated by exception: a property node carries `x-availableInVersionOverride` only when it is first read by a later release than the node above it, and an `enum` or `const` node's `x-valueAvailableInVersionOverride` lists `{value, availableInVersion}` only for the values first read by a later release than the node. The release from which a location in a document is read is the newest one stated on the path from the root to it: the key's `x-availableInVersion`, any override on a property node along the way (array items, map values and union alternatives add no level of their own), the value's own entry, and — inside a union alternative (a managed MCP server, OAuth, marketplace or inference-provider variant) — the release stated on that alternative's discriminator property (`server`, `mode`, `transport`, `source`, `provider`, …): its override, or the entry for its value; the alternative's other properties and any key repeated inside it are read no earlier than that.
